status_summary: H.R. 7085, introduced on 2026-01-15 and referred to the Financial Services Committee, would repeal only the conflict minerals disclosure requirement (Exchange Act section 13(p) and Dodd-Frank section 1502); it does not touch mine safety, resource extraction or pay ratio. The committee ordered it reported as amended by a 30 to 24 vote on 2026-01-22, and the Congressional Budget Office published its estimate on 2026-02-27. On 2026-03-19 the committee reported the bill (H. Rept. 119-560) and it was placed on the Union Calendar (No. 481); the bill status record shows no floor or Senate action. Separately, an SEC proposal published 2026-05-21 (91 FR 30086) would let non-accelerated filers forgo pay ratio disclosure and certain resource extraction payment disclosures, but it is a proposal and not a repeal.

timeline.event: H.R. 7085 was introduced to repeal the Exchange Act conflict minerals disclosure requirement and Dodd-Frank section 1502, and referred to the House Financial Services Committee.
The House Financial Services Committee ordered H.R. 7085 reported as amended by a recorded vote of 30 to 24.
H.R. 7085 was reported as amended by the House Financial Services Committee (H. Rept. 119-560) and placed on the Union Calendar (No. 481).
The SEC published a proposal (91 FR 30086) to extend smaller reporting company and emerging growth company disclosure accommodations to non-accelerated filers; the comment period ended 2026-07-20.
